title: CSM Executive Update Snapshot + Playbook
body:
Purpose and audience:
This is a compact, two-track deliverable for Customer Success Managers: a 1-page executive sponsor update (internal-facing talking points + pre-read) and a pair of customer-facing quarterly recap email drafts (concise & narrative). Use this in the week before a QBR or renewal touch to align execs and deliverable content quickly.

How to use this file:
- Copy the "pre-read" section into the meeting invite (PDF or simple doc).
- Use the "talk track" bullets for the sponsor call and to prep SE/AE.
- Send one of the two email drafts as the customer-facing recap after the QBR (choose based on relationship tone).
- Fill the KPI placeholders ({{}}) and update the Renewal Row before sending.

1) One-page Executive Sponsor Pre-read (attach to invite)
Title: QBR Snapshot — [CustomerName] — Redwood Inference
- Meeting owner: CSM (Aisha Patel) | Date: [YYYY-MM-DD] | Duration: 30–45m
- Objective: Align on product impact, operational health, renewal posture, and 90-day asks 
Key outcomes we’ll seek:
- Confirm continued business value (feature usage -> cost/latency wins)
- Agree on items required for renewal and/or expansion

Top-line metrics (fill before send):
- Active routes: {{active_routes}} | Avg latency p95: {{latency_p95}}ms
- Monthly tokens (hosted): {{monthly_tokens}} | Cost per 1k tokens: {{cost_per_1k}}
- Uptime (last 90d): {{uptime_pct}}% | Incidents: {{incidents_count}}
- Business impact 90d: {{customer_metric_change}} (e.g., search-relevance +6%)
- Health status: GREEN / YELLOW / RED (explain below)

Operational highlights and risks
- Recent wins: e.g., moved critical workflow to cached routes -> 35% cost drop on high-volume job
- Active risks: e.g., KV cache sizing causing cold starts for long-context jobs (mitigation: increase cache quota / patch rollout planned)
- Support summary: open Sev1/2/3s and expected closure dates (list ticket ids)

Renewal posture (current state)
- Contract end: {{contract_end}} | Renewal likelihood: High/Medium/Low
- Ask from sponsor: Exec affirmation on renewal + intro to procurement (if needed)

Proposed 90-day success plan (brief)
- Q1: Optimize batching and enable prefix cache for route X (owner: SE)
- Q2: Pilot Dedicated pool + cost baseline (owner: Eng/SE)
- Q3: Evaluate Private deployment if compliance gating (owner: Solutions Eng)

Attachments / prep items for execs
- Link to live dashboard (latency/cost): {{dashboard_link}}
- Short demo checklist (2–3 screenshots)
- Renewal one-pager (commercial terms summary)

2) Sponsor Call Talk Track (script bullets)
- 0–3m: Quick greetings, confirm agenda, ask if sponsor has any new top-level priorities
- 3–10m: Top-line business signal — "Since our last QBR you’ve seen X — that maps to $/time saved / retention gain..." (use customer KPI)
- 10–20m: Operational health — quick summary of uptime, latency, incidents, and mitigation plan
- 20–30m: Renewal ask and next steps — "We’d like to confirm renewal by [date]. What would make that an easy yes for you?"
- Close: Confirm follow-ups, owners, and timeline; offer a brief customer-facing recap email after the meeting

3) Customer-facing Quarterly Recap — Short variant (for execs who prefer concise comms)
Subject: [CustomerName] — QBR Recap & Next Steps
Hi [SponsorName],
Thanks for your time today. Quick recap:
- Business impact: {{one-line-impact}}
- Platform health: Uptime {{uptime_pct}}%, p95 latency {{latency_p95}}ms
- Immediate asks: Confirm renewal by {{renewal_target_date}}; provide procurement contact if needed
Next steps: CSM will send renewal one-pager and schedule a technical follow-up with Solutions Eng the week of {{date}}.
Thanks,
Aisha Patel (CSM)

4) Customer-facing Quarterly Recap — Narrative variant (for relationship-driven execs)
Subject: Highlights from our QBR — [CustomerName] & Redwood Inference
Hi [SponsorName],
Appreciate you making time today. A few highlights from the discussion and what we’re tracking for the next quarter: 
What went well:
- Migrated high-volume inference for Route X to cached routes, reducing per-request cost by ~35% and improving end-user response time.
Metrics to watch:
- Monthly tokens: {{monthly_tokens}} | p95 latency: {{latency_p95}}ms | Uptime: {{uptime_pct}}%
Open items and asks:
- We recommend piloting a Dedicated capacity pool for peak-hour throughput. We’ll send a pilot proposal and cost baseline by {{date}}.
- Renewal: Our contract ends on {{contract_end}}. To ensure uninterrupted service and budget planning, could you confirm the renewal cadence and procurement contact?
Action owners and timeline:
- CSM (Aisha): provide renewal one-pager by {{date}}
- SE (Daniel): deliver pilot SOW by {{date}}
- Eng (Lena): ETA on KV cache patch: {{eta}}
Thanks again and happy to iterate on the proposal with your procurement team.
Warmly,
Aisha Patel | Customer Success Manager

5) Quick Renewal Tracker Snippet (pasteable)
CustomerName,ContractEnd,RenewalLikelihood,PrimarySponsor,ProcurementContact,NextAction,NextActionDate
[CustomerName],{{contract_end}},High,[SponsorName],[ProcurementName],Send renewal one-pager,{{renewal_target_date}}

6) Playbook checklist for CSMs (pre-meeting)
- Update dashboard snapshots (latency, cost, routes) — attach PDFs
- Run smoke test of customer dev routes and capture 2–3 sample responses
- Confirm AE/SE availability for technical deep-dive follow-up
- Draft and attach renewal one-pager (commercial owner: AE)
- Post-meeting: choose short or narrative recap and send within 24h

7) Common objections and response templates
- "We can’t renew until procurement finalizes budgets." -> "Understood — can we confirm procurement timeline and a single point of contact so we can align a smooth renewal that avoids interruption?"
- "Latency spike is a blocker." -> "We’ll push the KV cache patch and schedule a dedicated triage session within 48h; estimated mitigation rollout: {{eta}}."

Notes / open questions (fill during prep):
- Is the customer evaluating alternatives? {{competitive_risk}}
- Any pending security/compliance asks that could necessitate Private deployment? {{compliance_flag}}

Version history:
- 2025-02-15: Initial draft (Aisha)
- 2025-03-03: Added renewal tracker snippet and narrative email variant (Lena)

---
This is intended to be lean and copy/paste-friendly — drop into meeting invites, CRM notes, or the QBR slide deck. Keep one canonical copy per customer in their account folder and link to the live dashboards before you send the pre-read.
